description: Ensure module independence across apps and packages (apps/web, apps/admin, packages/*): no direct cross-app imports, no cross-module Model imports, and no Mongoose .populate() calls.

forbiddenImports.reason: Module boundary violation: Direct imports of Mongoose models from other modules are prohibited. Use ObjectId + Repository/Service interface or @fquiz/models.
FQuiz database standard violation: Do not use Mongoose .populate(). Use batch queries with $in for application-level joins.
